description: Call this when the user asks how much leverage an exchange allows on a coin, what the maintenance margin or risk limit ladder is, which venue offers the highest leverage for a symbol, or whether an exchange recently cut leverage. Returns the current ladder per venue (tier, notional floor and cap, max leverage, maintenance margin rate) recorded daily by ByKaranteli, plus a change log. Pass symbol for one base asset (e.g. SOL) and venue for one exchange (bybit, okx, gate, htx, bitget, mexc).

symbol.description: string, optional base asset, e.g. BTC

venue.description: string, optional venue id, e.g. bybit

name: get_leverage_tiers
title: Leverage tiers: max leverage and maintenance margin per perpetual on every venue
